This is a map for "zombie escape" mode

Welcome, welcome to the Rooms testing institution. Please turn right and enter our testing room as the first one
Today's task is to follow the prompts of the lights to enter the corresponding room, turn on the instrument, collect energy balls through the portal, and then return
Before starting the task, we would like to remind you of the following points:
Firstly, pay attention to natural disasters caused by rainy and snowy weather.
Secondly, our former experimenters lost some equipment across the portal, which were disposable tools. We encourage you to use them to get out of trouble, but some equipment can also be harmful to you. Please be careful to distinguish between them
Thirdly, we understand that you may feel fearful of the unknown and refuse to pass through the portal, but please be prepared to face even more terrifying unknowns
Fourthly, we do not object to you deceiving the portal with your cleverness, but please be prepared to take on unpredictable consequences
After collecting enough energy balls and completing the mission, we will use the portal to send you safely out of here. Wishing you a safe and enjoyable day.
